title: A first for CRISPR: powerful prime editing alters DNA directly in the human body
title_zh: CRISPR首次取得突破：强大的prime editing直接在人体内编辑DNA
abstract: Application of the high-precision technique is part of a clinical trial to treat a genetic disease that can cause liver and nerve damage.
abstract_zh: 这种高精度技术的应用是临床试验的一部分，旨在治疗一种可能导致肝脏和神经损伤的遗传病。
